howItWorks.title: A simple, transparent and secure connection
howItWorks.subtitle: Every step is designed to protect parents' investment and promote teachers' excellence.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Specify your child's grade, subject (Math, French, Physics...), budget, and neighborhood in Conakry or online.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Receive applications from tutors whose degrees and identity have been manually verified by administration.
howItWorks.step3Desc: The tutor submits a lesson report. Payout only occurs IF you confirm that the session took place.

simulator.title: Zero surprises: Exact 15% / 85% breakdown
simulator.subtitle: Monthly packages are split into exact per-session unit value. A session is only paid to the tutor when completed and confirmed.
simulator.bulletPackage: Standard monthly package: 400,000 GNF for 8 sessions of 60 min
simulator.footnote: * The 250,000 GNF remain held and are never paid to the tutor until lessons are completed and confirmed by the parent.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about how Monsieur Fanyi works.
faq.a1: Every tutor must provide official identification (National ID or Passport) and university diplomas. Our admin team manually reviews and verifies every profile before authorizing applications.
faq.q2: What payment methods are supported in Guinea?
faq.a2: The platform is designed for Orange Money Guinea and MTN Mobile Money. As part of this rollout, transactions are audited with full traceability and manual reconciliation.
faq.q3: What happens if a lesson does not take place?
faq.a3: If a tutor did not show up or the lesson did not happen, the parent can contest the session with one click. Funds remain protected and are not released. The administrator reviews and can reschedule or refund.
